en.askTitle: Swap in your own family, pay and company support to get the same school, area and savings comparison before you commit to a posting
en.runTitle: A Korean family of four posted to Ho Chi Minh City from March 2027: which school, which area, and what they can save

fields.label: Adults and children’s ages
fields.value: two adults aged 41 and 39; children aged 9 and 13

fields.label: Salary and allowance
fields.value: KRW 7.5 million a month net plus a USD 1,200 monthly overseas allowance

fields.label: Rent cap and school-fee share paid by the company
fields.value: rent up to USD 2,500 a month and half of school fees

fields.label: Schools to compare
fields.value: the Korean international school in Ho Chi Minh City and 2–3 international schools

fields.label: Areas to compare
fields.value: District 7 (Phu My Hung) vs Thu Duc (Thao Dien / An Phu)

fields.label: Plant location
fields.placeholder: e.g. a factory in Saigon Hi-Tech Park or in the Tan Thuan export zone

en.template: Help me plan a posting to Ho Chi Minh City starting {start_date} for {years}. My family is {family}; pay is {pay}; the company covers {support}. Compare {schools} and {areas} against the plant location {plant}, rebuild the monthly budget and savings with my own grocery, insurance and tax figures, and flag anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Four colleagues split the research: residence and work rules, schools, housing areas, health cover and exchange rates
phases.note: Rule texts, school fee schedules, dated rent examples and live rates
phases.judgment: A colleague found that Decree 219/2025 appears to have replaced the older work-permit decree (inferred from secondary sources; its repeal clause was not read), and that the intra-company exemption may not cover a manufacturing manager. The guide therefore plans for a regular work permit and labels the apostille start date as coming from secondary sources only.

phases.title: Two follow-up colleagues cover the gaps (return to Korean schools, pension and tax, daily costs) while the guide is written
phases.note: A school-by-school savings comparison and the three deliverable files
phases.judgment: Where a figure could not be read, it was left out rather than guessed: no petrol price went into the guide because the official table would not load, and the Korean return-to-school rules are labelled as coming from one regional education office, not the Ministry.

phases.title: Recompute every money figure, check claims against the source list, then check the page on desktop and phone widths
phases.judgment: The guide’s author ran a second pass that recomputed every money figure from the raw inputs using a different method, and all matched. It also admitted a weakness in plain words: about VND 37.1M of the VND 44.2M monthly living subtotal is planning allowances, not priced facts, so the savings are indicative.

workers: Looked into Vietnam’s work permit, residence card and family visas, including who applies, documents and apostilles
Compared Phu My Hung with Thao Dien and An Phu using dated rent examples, drive times to factory areas and Korean community life
Compared the Korean school with three international schools on published fees, entry timing and language support
Checked health insurance and hospital billing, social insurance rules for foreigners, electricity tariffs and exchange rates
Followed up on rules for children returning to Korean schools, pension and tax treaties, and Korean-language hospital service
Followed up on published prices for cleaners, childcare, ride-hailing and home internet
